attribute_fields.COMMENTS: Utah state income tax calculation. Implements flat 4.5% rate with Taxpayer Tax Credit and Social Security exemption per Utah tax code (2025). Source: Utah State Tax Commission.

initial_action.action_postfix: "Utah Tax Calculation Started" job.audit_trail swap addto 0.0 /result.ut_taxable_income xdef 0.0 /result.ut_base_tax xdef 0.0 /result.ut_taxpayer_credit xdef 0.0 /result.ut_social_security_exemption xdef 0.0 /result.ut_tax xdef

condition_details.condition_description: Filing status is Married Filing Jointly
condition_details.condition_postfix: result.filing_status "married_filing_jointly" eq result.filing_status "Married Filing Jointly" eq or result.filing_status "MFJ" eq or

condition_details.condition_description: Filing status is Head of Household
condition_details.condition_postfix: result.filing_status "head_of_household" eq result.filing_status "Head of Household" eq or result.filing_status "HOH" eq or

action_details.action_comment: Calculate UT tax for single filer
action_details.action_postfix:
result.agi result.military_retirement_pay result.ut_military_retirement_taxable sub sub 0 max /ut_agi xdef
result.total_social_security 0 gt { result.total_social_security /result.ut_social_security_exemption xdef ut_agi result.total_social_security sub 0 max /ut_agi xdef "UT Social Security exemption: $" result.ut_social_security_exemption cvs strconcat job.audit_trail swap addto } if
ut_agi result.standard_deduction sub 0 max dup /ut_taxable_income xdef /result.ut_taxable_income xdef
ut_taxable_income result.ut_tax_rate mul dup /ut_base_tax xdef /result.ut_base_tax xdef
result.standard_deduction result.ut_personal_exemption result.num_dependents mul add result.ut_taxpayer_credit_rate mul /ut_credit xdef
result.agi result.ut_credit_phaseout_single gt { result.agi result.ut_credit_phaseout_single sub result.ut_credit_phaseout_rate mul /ut_phaseout xdef
ut_credit ut_phaseout sub 0 max /ut_credit xdef } if
ut_credit /result.ut_taxpayer_credit xdef
ut_base_tax ut_credit sub 0 max dup /ut_tax xdef /result.ut_tax xdef
ut_tax /result.state_tax_liability xdef
"Utah tax (Single) calculated: $" result.state_tax_liability cvs strconcat " (Base: $" strconcat result.ut_base_tax cvs strconcat ", Credit: $" strconcat result.ut_taxpayer_credit cvs strconcat ")" strconcat job.audit_trail swap addto

attribute_fields.COMMENTS: Utah military retirement exclusion calculation. UT allows up to $10,000 exemption on military retirement pay with income caps: Single $50k, Joint $65k AGI. Must choose between military retirement or Social Security exemption. Honors MSRRA and SCRA per federal law. Source: MOAA State Report Card.

initial_action.action_description: Initialize UT military retirement exclusion calculation
initial_action.action_postfix: "UT Military Retirement Exclusion Calculation Started" job.audit_trail swap addto 0.0 /result.ut_military_retirement_taxable xdef

condition_details.condition_postfix: result.filing_status "Single" eq result.filing_status "single" eq or result.agi result.ut_military_exemption_agi_cap_single le and
result.filing_status "married_filing_jointly" eq result.filing_status "MFJ" eq or result.agi result.ut_military_exemption_agi_cap_joint le and

action_details.action_comment: Apply UT $10,000 military retirement exemption (within AGI cap)
action_details.action_postfix:
result.military_retirement_pay result.ut_military_retirement_exemption min /ut_exemption_amount xdef
result.military_retirement_pay ut_exemption_amount sub 0 max /result.ut_military_retirement_taxable xdef
"UT military retirement exemption applied: $" ut_exemption_amount cvs strconcat " (Retirement pay: $" strconcat result.military_retirement_pay cvs strconcat ", AGI: $" strconcat result.agi cvs strconcat ", Taxable: $" strconcat result.ut_military_retirement_taxable cvs strconcat ")" strconcat job.audit_trail swap addto

result.military_retirement_pay /result.ut_military_retirement_taxable xdef
"UT military retirement exemption not applicable - AGI exceeds cap: $" result.agi cvs strconcat " (Fully taxable: $" strconcat result.ut_military_retirement_taxable cvs strconcat ")" strconcat job.audit_trail swap addto

action_details.action_comment: No military retirement pay - no exemption
action_details.action_postfix: 0.0 /result.ut_military_retirement_taxable xdef "No UT military retirement pay - exemption not applicable" job.audit_trail swap addto
